purpose: The Book of Changes as a finite change/correspondence instrument: one exact six-line address per state, with primary (本卦) / transformed (之卦) / nuclear (互卦) readings and structural operations over all 64. 0.6 adds the radial wheel — the same 64 as one object, walked clockwise in King Wen order, or sorted by six-bit address.
laws: READ THE CHINESE FIRST — 周易 is authoritative; English is a public-domain reduction
A LENS, NOT AN ORACLE — symbolic correspondence is not native control state, body measurement or world proof
RECOVER BEFORE INVENTING — the arrangement is computed from the data already shipped; no new fields
ONE OBJECT, MANY PROJECTIONS — the wheel and the Walk strip are the same 64 in two renderings
PROVENANCE ON EVERY LAYER — 周易 public domain · Legge 1882 public domain · Human Design 1987 labelled as a modern lens
visible_delta: radial wheel: 64 spokes, King Wen order clockwise from the top (№ 1 乾 → № 64 未濟)
outward bar = judgment 卦辭 character count; inward marks = the six lines, bottom → top (yang one mark, yin two)
hover reads a spoke out in text; activating a spoke opens that hexagram
second ordering: the same 64 sorted by six-bit address (binary / Fu Xi order)
held hexagram marked on its spoke, on its rim glyph and in the hub
accessibility: the canvas carries an aria-label, the hub readout is aria-live, and the Walk strip remains the linear, keyboard-readable projection of the same object
layout_grammar: Movements of Change / Visualizing I-Ching (Yvette Shen, OSU designviz; Information is Beautiful showcase) — outward bars = text weight, inward marks = line stages. Grammar reference only; the renderer is this repository's own dependency-free canvas code.
access: static — 2 files, zero dependencies, zero tracking, no network write
